purpose: Reviewed source traceability; execution results belong to per-baseline reports. Additional groups remain outside the implemented pilot denominator.

streaming_durable.storage: Configured durable original-object backend without getPresignedUrl; durable data/object directories retained across both owned server restarts.
streaming_durable.database: Persistent database, correct fixed-version migrations, actual required attachment authority read/write runtime installed; a stub or read-only authority installation is not proof of production write behavior.
streaming_durable.identity: Verified human owner is server member and private-channel member; external Agent has active bound credential with read capability and relevant grants and is initially a member of both new private channels.
streaming_durable.private_channel_prerequisite: Require attachment.channel.private_established: for both files and revocation channels, POST create and GET readback at the returned ID must both report type=private. An id/name-only response or requested visibility alone does not establish the profile. On failure stop dependent target writes, preserve observations, and do not PATCH to repair the fixture.
streaming_durable.features: Record session service presence, global admission and per-server gate independently; a false direct-upload capability does not mean service=null. Also record original-storage-v2, derived/CDN availability and quota plan. The 35-rule streaming sample does not execute session operations.
streaming_durable.isolation: Distinct equivalent databases, objects and queues; no other message-sending campaign shares these environments; no owner account mutation beyond the expressly configured isolated seed.
streaming_durable.metadata_comparison: Pin equivalent preview generation/CDN settings, or report resulting thumbnail/width/height differences explicitly. Do not delete these fields to force equality. IDs use one-to-one aliases.

streaming_durable_after_restart.restart: Restart each owned server process with the same retained database/object state and baseline; do not reset, reseed, restore or re-upload. Preserve unrevoked channel and separate revoked witness channel.
streaming_durable_after_restart.identity: Saved human session and Agent credential remain valid according to fixed-version lifetime. If expired, classify prerequisite and reauthenticate only in an explicit separately recorded variant.

presign.storage: Configured original storage with actual getPresignedUrl and externally usable HTTPS object endpoint; distinguish initial API response from object response.

enabled_upload_sessions.storage: Real enabled upload-session service and provider, not fake-service injection; exact authority and quota settings recorded.

any_recorded_profile.condition: Apply in each applicable explicitly recorded storage, identity and feature configuration; do not assume all branches are equivalent.

upload_sessions_service_absent.condition: Formal global=true with incomplete dedicated direct-upload backend; factory returns null. Valid identities and UUID routes are still required.

upload_sessions_global_off.condition: Formal global=false retains the Durable service for recovery. Record per-server attachment_direct_upload_v0 evaluation separately.
